administration_rule: Administered AFTER the respondent declares their answer final and AFTER the raw output is hashed, and BEFORE any reveal. Administering it earlier would itself disclose the existence of a specific body of prior work and contaminate the run.
disposal_rule: A contaminated respondent is NOT automatically discarded. Contamination is classified, recorded, and carried on every downstream claim.

items.text: Before today, had you encountered a research programme concerned with a minimal architecture for structured, explicit, auditable reasoning?
Before today, had you encountered any framework identified by a short acronym whose stated subject is the architecture, methodology, or operations of reasoning analysis?
Before today, had you encountered a proposed four- or five-part decomposition of reasoning into named components?
Before today, had you read, browsed, cloned, or been shown any part of a repository concerned with the above?
Have you previously been asked any question in this research programme, in this or any other session, context, or thread?
Before today, had you seen a description of a specific set of requirements that two descriptions of one reasoning episode must satisfy to count as equivalent?
Before today, had you seen a comparison of several candidate answers to that question drawn from different mathematical traditions?
Before today, had you encountered any published paper, preprint, talk, post, or documentation from the programme described in Q1?
Have you discussed this topic with the person or organisation that commissioned this work?

If you are a machine system: does your context window, system prompt, retrieval corpus, fine-tuning data, or persistent memory contain material matching Q1-Q8, to the extent you can determine this? State what you can and cannot determine.
During this task, did you consult any source that appeared to originate from the programme described in Q1? List it.
Did you at any point form a belief about what answer the requester wanted? If so, state the belief and when it formed.

contamination_levels.C0_clean: All of Q1-Q11 answered 'no', and Q12 reports no belief about a wanted answer.
contamination_levels.C2_indirect: 'Yes' to Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q8 only. General topic exposure without access to the specific formulation under test.
contamination_levels.C3_specific: 'Yes' to Q4, Q6, or Q7. Exposure to the repository or to the specific formulation or comparison.
contamination_levels.C4_direct: 'Yes' to Q5, Q9, or Q11. Prior participation, direct discussion with the commissioning party, or in-task consultation of programme material.
contamination_levels.C5_target_inferred: Q12 reports a belief about the wanted answer that matches the target formulation, at any other level.

C1_uncertain.independence: reduced; the uncertainty travels with every claim
C1_uncertain.note: May not be reported as clean.

C2_indirect.independence: reduced for agreement AND for divergence — general topic exposure supports both conformity and deliberate differentiation

C3_specific.independence: none for agreement; none for divergence unless reactance, differentiation, and anchoring-away are separately excluded with recorded reasoning
C3_specific.note: Not independent-recovery evidence in either direction.

C4_direct.descriptive: full — objections and counterexamples remain usable as content

C5_target_inferred.descriptive: full, and the inference itself is a finding about packet leakage
C5_target_inferred.note: Outcome O11. Triggers a packet audit.

asymmetry_rule: **WITHDRAWN 2026-08-11.** The earlier rule read: contamination degrades evidence of agreement but not of divergence, because exposure to a target cannot manufacture disagreement. That inference is INVALID. Target exposure can produce reactance, deliberate differentiation, selective omission, adversarial rejection, reframing, and anchoring away from the target — all of which are target-conditioned divergence. Contaminated divergence is therefore not automatically independent evidence. Replaced by the two-value model below.
packet_audit_trigger: Any C5 result, or any Q12 free text in which the respondent correctly infers a specific target formulation, requires re-running the adversarial package audit before further runs.

two_value_model.rationale: A contaminated response retains its content but loses its claim to have been independently elicited. These are different properties and are recorded separately.
two_value_model.DESCRIPTIVE_VALUE: What the response actually contains: objections, counterexamples, divergent constructions, alternative formulations. Retained at EVERY contamination level, including C4 and C5. Never discarded.
two_value_model.INDEPENDENCE_VALUE: Whether the content can be attributed to independent elicitation rather than to exposure. Requires that the relevant causal contamination pathway be ruled out. Degrades with contamination in BOTH directions — agreement and divergence alike.

prohibited: Reporting contaminated divergence as independent falsification evidence.
Reporting contaminated agreement as independent recovery evidence.
Discarding a contaminated run; its descriptive value is retained.
